title: Post-install assertion sweep for VPC TF modules: API handshake, model soak and smoke probe runner
creator: Aisha Patel
description: When a customer VPC/private deployment finishes Terraform apply and the control-plane is handed over, we need an automated, opinionated 'assertion sweep' that validates API readiness, model loadability, and a targeted smoke/soak run of generated traffic. This ticket builds the orchestrator that invokes IaC postinstall hooks, runs a configurable probe matrix, and surfaces structured results to the Console and runbooks.
acceptance_criteria: Orchestrator can be triggered as a Terraform null_resource local-exec hook and as a standalone operator job
API handshake probe returns 200 and returns a valid model list within 5s for >=95% of attempts in a healthy run
Model load test loads pinned model variant (customer config) and completes a warmup generation (<=2s per token for first 64 tokens) for 90% of attempts in a 5-run sample
Smoke generator executes a small prompt corpus (10 prompts) and validates deterministic shape/keys for structured output; failures are categorized (timeout, tokenization, model OOM)
Probe results are recorded as structured artifacts (S3/drive link) and a summarized status pushed to the Console runbook and to the deployment Slack channel
Failure modes produce clear remediation steps in the runbook and trigger the rollback policy when severity threshold exceeded
steps: Design a lightweight YAML probe spec (api_handshake, model_load, smoke, soak) that Terraform can pass via templatefile
Implement a Go-based prober service that reads the spec, runs probes in parallel with per-probe timeouts and retries
Add Kubernetes Job and standalone binary run modes (job templates for private deployments that don't want a long-lived pod)
Wire the prober to emit TRACE spans and metrics (prometheus + otel) for latency and error breakdowns
Create a Console view with latest sweep results, logs link and suggested remediation actions
Add a Terraform module example using null_resource "postinstall_assertion" with hooks to run the prober binary and upload artifacts
progress_updates: 2026-02-20 - Aisha: Created ticket after spike showing inconsistent post-apply readiness for large models; initial spec drafted and shared with infra and runtime teams
2026-02-23 - Marco: Prototype Go prober that can run API handshake and a single model warmup; pushed initial branch (github.com/redwood-inference/prober/tree/ENG-718202-proto)
2026-02-25 - Design review: Decided on YAML probe spec shape and failure severity levels (info/warn/fatal); Design suggested including KV cache check as separate probe
2026-02-27 - Infra: Added Terraform example module stub and null_resource example; flagged potential IAM role requirement for prober to upload artifacts to customer S3
2026-03-01 - Marco: End-to-end run on our dev VPC completed for small model. Observed 8% handshake timeouts when NAT gateway was under load; added retry backoff and jitter in prober
blockers: Intermittent NAT gateway throttling in integration account causing handshake timeouts
Customer VPCs with restrictive egress policies require clear IAM/EGRESS instructions; prober needs fallback to use bastion proxy
Consensus required on rollback severity thresholds across product and SRE
